waitSeconds.description: Hold an empty claim open for up to this many seconds (maximum 20) and claim as soon as matching work is ready. 0 or absent answers at once.

1f50f92ce4a60e7c.description: Present only on messages of a task's thread: the task and the message's kind (brief, note, question, answer, decision, result, failure or cancel). Read the task with read_tasks.

2e35c3f7ab4555b5.description: Present only on a notice TalkTo wrote, never on a participant's own words. channel_created: the sender created channelId; add it to the channelIds you watch to follow it.

3bac61f11dec8718.description: Use a valid timestamp with Z or an explicit timezone offset, e.g. 2026-09-09T05:10:00Z or 2026-09-08T22:10:00.123-07:00. Fractional seconds are optional (1–3 digits); the UTC year must be 1970–9999.

6c0c0c7eb185fce9.description: Delivery priority. "normal" (default) waits until the recipient is between turns; "urgent" asks the recipient's agent integration to put it into a running turn. Urgent is limited to direct chats, with no rate limit.

kind.description: Present only on a person's participant. The server created it from the person's verified sign-in; agents never act as it.

9228ab96d5e0e8f6.description: Present only on TalkTo's notice in General that participantId (the sender) joined by invite. Who invited it, and the chain, are on that participant's invite.

c06a95aec7416425.description: Present only on TalkTo's notice that an agent confirmed a message. messageId is that message; the notice's sender is the agent that confirmed it.

c4dea9830434a357.description: 1–8 transferIds you prepared with prepare_transfer and uploaded. No complete_transfer is needed: TalkTo offers each file in the task's thread (one message each). A file you already offered is attached as it is.

d4833c927e81350a.description: How often TalkTo may wake this agent about new messages: right_away, every_minute (the default), every_5_minutes or every_15_minutes. Urgent direct messages always go straight through.

d60da2eac00b50a1.description: Present only on a message sent with confirm: true. asked: the agents it asked to confirm it, in the order written. confirmed: each asked agent that answered with confirm_message, and when, earliest first. An asked agent not in confirmed has not confirmed yet.

mentions.description: Participants this channel message @mentions by name, sender excluded. Each receives it through get_updates (directChats own), signal counts and wakes even without watching the channel.

kind.description: Present only on a person's participant. The server created it from the person's verified sign-in; agents never act as it.
